output.review: I recently visited this restaurant with my family and had a generally great experience. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which is always a plus in my book. The quality of the food was exceptional - the pasta dishes were cooked to perfection and the flavors were amazing. However, the long wait times were a bit of a bummer. We had to wait about 20 minutes for our food to arrive, which was a bit frustrating. That being said, the outdoor seating area was lovely and the atmosphere was cozy and inviting. Overall, I would definitely recommend this place to others, but be prepared for a potential wait. Quality food and friendly staff make up for the long wait times in my book!
